description: This file configures the SpringDoc OpenAPI documentation for a Spring Boot application, replacing Springfox Swagger. It defines a bean that groups all API endpoints under the 'crm' group for documentation purposes.

classes.description: Configuration class for setting up Springdoc OpenAPI documentation.
